name: Dev Tools Dir
conditions: Free Launch requires BOTH: adding their badge to your site and verifying the backlink, AND your site's Domain Rating must be at least 10 at submission time.
Free listings are 'reviewed and listed within up to 30 days'.
requirements: Developer tools focus: curated directory of dev tools, APIs, SDKs, infrastructure, backend services (though category list is broad — 100+ categories).
Account required: /projects/submit redirects to sign-in (Google, GitHub, or email/password).
Your site's DR ≥ 10 is a hard floor for the free plan — new domains are ineligible without paying.
preparation: Check your domain's Ahrefs DR — must be ≥10 for the free plan.
Project name, URL, description, category, logo.
Badge embed ready for free-tier verification.

Plan choice: Free (badge + DR≥10, ~30 days) / Premium $9.9 (priority, guaranteed dofollow, 10 slots/day) / Premium Plus $12.9 (featured styling 14 days, spotlight, 3/day) / DR Booster $50 (10 network backlinks).
workflow: Sign in at devtoolsdir.com, then open /projects/submit.
Complete the form; free tier additionally installs the badge and verifies the backlink.
Wait for review — up to 30 days on free; premium tiers get earlier 8:00 AM UTC launch dates.
watchFor: The DR ≥ 10 floor on the free plan is unusual — brand-new sites literally cannot use the free lane.
Badge + verified backlink requirement stacks with the DR floor on free.
DR Booster ($50 for 10 backlinks across their niche-directory network) is a paid link scheme — evaluate carefully; the page markets real-customer Ahrefs charts.
Same DirEasy boilerplate family as fastlaunch.io — identical 'Choose Your Launch Plan' framing and 8:00 AM UTC launch time.
Heavy footer badge/link farm (20+ 'Featured on' badges, many duplicated).
countsAsLive: A public project page on devtoolsdir.com listed under its category after an 8:00 AM UTC launch cycle.
unknowns: Submit form field list behind sign-in.
Whether DR is re-checked after approval.
Exact queue length for free vs premium.
